name: davx5-contacts
about: Non-demo app (T55): DAVx5 4.5.21-ose (F-Droid release APK) syncing one shared CardDAV address book on a local Radicale server. Each device adds contacts through the Android contacts provider (adb) and presses Sync (Maestro) while its network drops; the proxy log is judged. scripts/check-run-app.mjs downloads the APK to .cache/ and starts Radicale. Profiles skip API 31: there the Maestro driver died mid-flow (device server died / adb device not found), the known API 31 low-memory limit in docs/adr/0007-agent-helper.md.

adb: content insert --uri content://com.android.contacts/raw_contacts --bind account_type:s:at.bitfire.davdroid.address_book --bind 'account_name:s:crew (crew) #1' && id=$(content query --uri content://com.android.contacts/raw_contacts --projection _id --where 'display_name IS NULL' --sort '_id DESC' | head -1 | sed 's/.*_id=//') && content insert --uri content://com.android.contacts/data --bind raw_contact_id:i:$id --bind mimetype:s:vnd.android.cursor.item/name --bind 'data1:s:{serial} c{iter}'
